name: Husqvarna 3120 XP
blurb: 32″, 44″ and 60″ bar setups on .404″ chain, .063″ gauge, 95–172 drive links — straight from Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide.
intro: The Husqvarna 3120 XP is a rear-handle gas saw. Husqvarna's own 2026 Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (effective 1 January 2026) lists 3 approved bar lengths for it (32″, 44″ and 60″), running .404″ pitch chain in .063″ gauge. The guide also lists a 72″ bar (190 drive links) whose file-size cell is a typo in the PDF, so we have not published that row.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 32″ setup with bar X-Tough 596690095 and chain H64S 591164495.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 44″ setup with bar Solid, RSN 608000144 and chain H57S 591164628.

Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 60″ setup with bar Solid, RSN 608000146 and chain (no chain part number is printed for this length). (This is a very long solid bar; the guide lists the bar only.)

sources.title: Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide 2026 (effective 1 January 2026) — certified/approved bar and chain combinations per saw

sources_note: Husqvarna 2026 Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (effective 1 January 2026), read in full on 24 Oct 2026; every row in the table is restated from the saw's entry in that guide.
